Job Description
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Manager to join our ESG Consulting team, combining strong ESG domain experience with broad consulting and advisory capability.
  
  
You will lead client engagements across a range of ESG and sustainability topics, helping clients navigate complex requirements, address broader business and transformation challenges, and translate sustainability priorities into practical solutions and business outcomes.
  
  
The role requires someone who can operate across both depth and breadth: sufficiently rigorous to navigate complex ESG, regulatory, reporting, finance and risk considerations, while also being comfortable with ambiguity, structuring broader enterprise problems and bringing together multidisciplinary capabilities to develop integrated solutions.
  
  
As a Manager, you will be expected to lead engagements and teams, manage client relationships and engagement economics, contribute to business development, and help build the capabilities and propositions of the ESG Consulting practice.
  
  
What you will do -
  
  
Lead client engagements
  
  
Lead ESG consulting engagements across areas such as sustainability strategy and transformation, ESG reporting and disclosure, transition planning, climate risk, sustainable finance, sustainable supply chains, circularity, ESG risk and related areas.
  
Own day-to-day client relationships and guide client stakeholders through complex ESG and business issues.
  
Structure complex and ambiguous problems, establish clear approaches and guide engagement teams from analysis through recommendation and implementation.
  
Maintain oversight of engagement quality, ensuring conclusions and recommendations are robust, practical and appropriate to the client’s circumstances.
  
  
Translate complexity into practical solutions
  
  
Navigate ESG standards, regulatory and reporting requirements, methodologies and relevant finance and risk considerations, exercising judgement on their implications for clients.
  
Translate technical or regulatory requirements into practical business responses rather than stopping at interpretation or assessment.
  
Connect sustainability considerations to broader enterprise priorities, including strategy, finance, operations, supply chain, technology, workforce, risk and business performance.
  
Translate strategies and recommendations into practical roadmaps, operating changes, implementation plans and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Develop integrated solutions
  
  
Look beyond individual ESG issues to understand the broader client problem and identify opportunities for enterprise transformation and value creation.
  
Bring together capabilities across consulting, advisory and specialist teams to develop holistic client solutions.
  
Work effectively across functions and geographies, mobilising the appropriate expertise around the client’s needs.
  
Synthesise different perspectives and disciplines into a coherent client proposition and delivery approach.
  
  
Manage commercially successful engagements
  
  
Manage engagement scope, budgets, resourcing, timelines and delivery economics, balancing quality and client outcomes with profitable delivery.
  
Anticipate and actively manage scope changes, delivery risks and resource requirements.
  
Deploy teams effectively and make sound decisions on how work should be delivered.
  
Maintain a strong understanding of the client’s business and commercial context, ensuring our work addresses issues that matter to the client.
  
⠀
  
  
Grow client relationships and opportunities
  
  
Build trusted client relationships and develop a strong understanding of clients’ evolving business and ESG priorities.
  
Identify emerging or adjacent client needs and connect these to relevant capabilities across the firm.
  
Contribute to shaping propositions, proposals and commercially viable solutions.
  
Help convert existing relationships and engagements into appropriate follow-on opportunities.
  
Contribute to the development and evolution of ESG propositions in response to changing market and client needs.
  
  
Lead and develop teams
  
  
Lead multidisciplinary engagement teams, providing clear direction and maintaining accountability for delivery.
  
Review and challenge the work of junior team members while helping them develop stronger consulting judgement.
  
Coach team members in problem solving, client management, commercial discipline and high-quality delivery.
  
Create an environment where team members understand both the client outcome they are working towards and the commercial context of the engagement.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  
Substantial relevant professional experience in ESG and sustainability-related work, together with demonstrated consulting or advisory experience.
  
Breadth across multiple ESG areas, which may include sustainability strategy and transformation, ESG reporting and disclosure, transition planning, climate risk, sustainable finance, ESG risk, sustainable supply chains, circularity, assurance, verification or certification.
  
Strong consulting fundamentals, including problem structuring, analytical rigour, synthesis, professional judgement and development of practical recommendations.
  
Ability to operate comfortably across both structured and unstructured problems, from navigating complex requirements to addressing broader enterprise transformation challenges.
  
Strong client advisory capability, with the confidence and judgement to guide clients through complex issues, evaluate options and help them reach practical solutions.
  
Ability to connect issues across disciplines and bring together expertise from different teams and geographies to develop integrated solutions.
  
Strong application and implementation orientation, with a focus on translating advice into practical change and measurable outcomes.
  
Strong business and commercial acumen, with experience managing scope, resourcing, budgets and engagement economics.
  
Ability to recognise client needs, contribute to shaping opportunities and support the conversion of those needs into commercially viable work.
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, maintain quality and develop junior consultants.
  
  
What will distinguish you
  
You combine advisory depth, enterprise-level problem solving and commercial judgement.
  
  
You are comfortable getting into the detail when an issue requires rigour, but equally able to step back, understand the broader business problem and connect the capabilities required to solve it.
  
  
You see successful consulting as more than producing high-quality deliverables. You focus on helping clients arrive at practical solutions and implement change, while building trusted relationships, developing your team and delivering work with strong commercial discipline.

Job Description
  
  
As an Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Coordinator, you will support clients in the planning, implementation, management, and coordination of EHS requirements across operational facilities and office environments. You will play an important role in ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, promoting a strong safety culture, and supporting the effective management of environmental, health, and safety programmes.
  
  
The successful candidate will also be responsible for conducting and facilitating EHS seminars and training programmes, developing effective methods for monitoring EHS performance, and carrying out routine inspections to identify and mitigate potential workplace risks.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental, health, safety, and statutory legislation, regulations, and requirements.
  
  
Provide EHS policy guidance and support to clients, management teams, employees, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Review and advise on safe work procedures in collaboration with operational and project teams.
  
  
Conduct routine workplace inspections and audits to identify hazards and assess compliance with EHS requirements.
  
  
Recommend reasonably practicable measures to eliminate or minimise foreseeable risks to employees, visitors, and contractors.
  
  
Establish and promote EHS awareness and a positive safety culture across operational facilities and office environments.
  
  
Support the implementation and monitoring of environmental programmes, including waste management, environmental compliance, and sustainability initiatives, where required by the Client.
  
  
Monitor and review EHS programmes to ensure regulatory and organisational compliance.
  
  
Manage and maintain site- or facility-specific EHS documentation in accordance with client and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Respond to incidents and emergencies, assist in investigations, recommend corrective and preventive actions, and maintain accurate records and statistics.
  
  
Prepare and submit incident reports in accordance with EHS and organisational procedures.
  
  
Support the coordination and delivery of EHS inductions, briefings, awareness programmes, and training initiatives as required.
  
  
Perform other EHS-related duties and ad hoc assignments as required by the Client.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Opportunities are available across multiple experience levels, depending on the complexity of the assignment and scope of responsibilities.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health& Safety, Workplace Safety & Health, or a related discipline.
  
  
Up to 3 years of relevant experience in an EHS, facilities, operations, or similar environment. Experience supporting technology-sector clients will be an advantage.
  
  
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Placement level will be determined based on qualifications, experience, and available opportunities.
  
  
Strong interest in environmental, health, and safety management and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Positive attitude with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
Stronganalytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
  
  
Strong administrative and document management skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  
  
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and documentation management.
  
  
Knowledge of EHS regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices will be an advantage.

Contract (1 to 2 years), with extension or renewal subject to the Client's requirements and project needs.

description:
Are you passionate about sustainability? Do you want to take action?
  
  
The need to move to a more sustainable world has never been clearer. Companies have a big part to play, but many are not sure where to start. For 15 years, Sustainable Living Lab (SL2) has helped companies see sustainability as an opportunity rather than a cost. This is a turning point, and the choices we make now can set things on a better course. Join us in helping companies (and our planet) thrive by taking up more sustainable business practices and circular business models.
  
  
About SL2
  
  
SL2 is a sustainability consultancy and innovation lab founded in Singapore in 2011. We specialise in creating and implementing rapidly evolving, impactful solutions. Our expertise lies in leveraging technology as a tool for sustainability, with a strong emphasis on a community-driven approach to implementation. Our practical yet ambitious approach has helped us build a client base across governments, international development organisations, large multinationals, and small and medium-sized companies.
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, we have established a strong presence in Asia and beyond. Our strategically located offices in India, Indonesia, and the United States enable us to effectively engage, understand, and tailor our solutions to specific contexts.
  
  
About the Team
  
  
This role is based in Singapore and sits within the Corporate Sustainability Team. You will work with clients based in multiple locations and time zones across Asia. The team helps companies transition towards more sustainable business practices. We are a close-knit team that works at pace and collaborates by default, equally comfortable leading client workshops and managing the detail behind them. With clients across the region, no two weeks are the same, and we hold ourselves to a high standard in the work we deliver.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
You will work with companies, government bodies, and Institutes of Higher Learning across several countries by training them on sustainability concepts, helping them come up with new business ideas, and co-developing technology solutions. It is a hands-on role, and you will manage client relationships as well as handle the details that keep the work running.
  
  
**The work will involve:**  
**Account Management:**  
Working with clients through scoping, proposals, and delivery, and being their main point of contact throughout.
  
  
**Training Design and Delivery:**  
Assisting with the design and delivery of training and innovation programmes on sustainability, and keeping the content current with industry trends, new regulations, and best practices.
  
  
**Programme Management:**  
Collaborating with the Corporate Sustainability Team to design, implement, and manage sustainability programmes that align with our goals.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement:**  
Building and maintaining relationships with external stakeholders to drive sustainability initiatives.
  
  
About You
  
  
You should have relevant qualifications in sustainability and/ or business innovation. Ideally, you will also have:
  
  
Minimum of 2 years relevant work experience in corporate sustainability, environmental consulting, training, or a related field.
  
  
Some experience in running or helping to run training, workshops, or programmes for adults, or a real interest in learning how.
  
  
Strong understanding of sustainability principles and frameworks (e.g. ISSB, GRI, GHG Protocol), and best practices.
  
  
A working understanding of sustainability-related issues and trends in both a local and global context.
  
  
Basic understanding of innovation processes (e.g. Design Thinking, Business Model Canvas).
  
  
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, for writing reports, delivering presentations, and engaging with stakeholders at all levels in English.
  
  
Good time management (able to handle multiple clients/projects simultaneously).
  
  
Able to adapt to ambiguous contexts of contributing to a wide range of client projects unfolding simultaneously.
  
  
Ability to accommodate working hours to suit the needs of international clients who may be in a different time zone. Time Off will be provided in line with our internal policy.
  
  
Proficiency in Google Suite online tools.
  
  
**A bonus but not a must:** Advanced Certificate in Learning and Performance certification, or willingness to work towards it, which we can support.
  
  
If you learn fast and care about the problem we are tackling but do not tick every box, apply anyway. We have found that motivation often trumps qualifications in the long run.

**Company:** Digital Edge DC

### **Who we are**

Digital Edge DC (Digital Edge) is a leading data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. We seek to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve.

Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy-efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed capital.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, with 30+ data centers in operations and under construction, and this role is an exciting opportunity to join the team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

**Our values:**

** **

* **Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.**

* **Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.  **

* **Strive: We are driven and determined.**

* **Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.   **

* **Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.**

 

**What we need:**

* *

**What we need:**

Responsible for executing the company’s global Corporate Social Responsibility strategy, translating ESG direction into impactful, measurable programmes that drive both employee engagement and external social impact across all markets.

 

Reporting to the Head of ESG (Chief Sustainability Officer), this role operationalises the CSR platform by embedding CSR into the employee experience, strengthening community partnerships, and ensuring consistent delivery of initiatives aligned to the organisation’s ESG goals, brand, and values.

 

The role is highly collaborative, partnering closely with General Affairs, HR, Corporate Communications, country leadership and external stakeholders (which may include, joint venture partners, educational organizations, non-profit organizations, and community officials in the jurisdictions neighbouring our data centers, among others) to deliver scalable, high-impact programmes that enhance employee engagement, employer brand, and community outcomes.

 

### **Key responsibilities**

 

**CSR Strategy Execution and Programme Delivery**

* Operationalise the global CSR framework and pillars defined by the Head of ESG, ensuring consistent but localised implementation across all countries.

* Translate strategy into clear annual CSR roadmaps, programmes, and campaigns with defined KPIs and measurable outcomes.

* Drive execution of enterprise CSR priorities such as:

Develop greenhouse gas (GHG), carbon offset, and biodiversity replenishment programs, that are relevant to the data center industry, that align with our stated ESG goals

* Community engagement and impact

* STEM and education initiatives

* Environmental volunteering

* Inclusion and industry access

Ensure localisation of programmes while maintaining global alignment and brand consistency. Work with legal and compliance teams to vet our CSR partners

 

**Employee Engagement and HR Partnership**

 

* Partner with internal teams to embed CSR and culture-building into everyday life at Digital Edge.

* Design and implement employee volunteering frameworks, giving programmes and engagement campaigns.

* Position CSR as a core lever for:

Employee engagement and team building

* Personal development

* Culture and values activation

Develop toolkits and guidance for managers to drive participation at scale across all locations.

 

**External Education, Social Impact and Partnerships**

 

* Build and manage strategic partnerships with NGOs, educational institutions, community organisations and industry bodies

* Identify and scale initiatives that strengthen the company’s social licence to operate in local markets.

* Drive programmes aligned to workforce strategy (e.g. STEM pipelines, community talent development) including but not limited to Educational Institution relationships and curriculum building, employee guest lecturing and industry awareness initiatives

* Represent the company in CSR-related forums and partnerships as delegated by the Head of ESG.

 

**Governance, Measurement and Reporting**

** **

* Establish and maintain CSR metrics, dashboards, and reporting frameworks aligned to ESG reporting

* Track programme effectiveness including participation rates, social impact outcomes, and brand impact.

* Support ESG reporting cycles by providing robust CSR data and narratives for:

Annual sustainability reports

* Investor and customer disclosures

* Employer branding and communications

Ensure strong governance and consistency across markets.

 

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

 

* Work closely with:

Corporate Communications on storytelling and brand amplification

* Country leadership on local execution

* Commercial and customer teams where CSR supports customer engagement or RFP positioning

Act as the central coordination point for CSR activity across the organisation.

 

**Culture, Capability and Internal Awareness**

 

* Build internal awareness and capability around CSR through:

Campaigns and communications

* Leadership engagement

* Employee storytelling

Embed CSR as a visible and tangible part of the company’s purpose and values. Support a culture of community contribution, inclusivity and responsible business practices

 

**The successful candidate:**

* 8+ years of experience in CSR, social impact or related fields in a multi geographical role.

* Proven track record in executing multi-country CSR or employee engagement programmes.

* Experience working in complex, matrixed organisations across Asia or globally.

* Strong partnership experience with HR, Communications and external stakeholders.

* Experience in sectors such as infrastructure, technology, data centres or industrial environments preferred

 

**Key Attributes**

 

* Execution-focused operator with the ability to translate strategy into delivery at scale.

* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability across all levels.

* Commercially aware, with the ability to align CSR outcomes to business priorities.

* Highly collaborative, culturally aware and adaptable across markets.

* Strong communication skills with the ability to connect purpose, people and impact.
